body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary restraint until this movement ends, then move up to 3 units into cover or concealment. If no such destination exists, move 1 unit. The restraint resumes if its source still reaches you.

surges.html: End the suppressed restraint if it is mundane and you leave its source's reach.

rider.title: Contingency - Evasion
rider.html: When an enemy enters within 1 unit of your destination, you may move 2 units farther into existing cover without triggering its movement Reactions.
